lines.3: 「Could you yawn with a little more dignity?」
lines.4: 「Isn't anything fun happening? Come on, make me laugh.」
lines.7: Crab rocked her chair noisily up and down.
lines.8: 「You really can't sit still, can you?」
lines.11: 「Ahem, testing. Can you hear me? This is student council president Erika Kiriya.」
lines.12: 「I've got a bad feeling about this.」
lines.13: The fact that the Princess's voice alone could silence the noisy classroom was impressive.
lines.14: 「We have just received word from the Kanagawa Prefectural Police that three captured stray dogs escaped from a truck en route to the public health center.」
lines.15: 「They escaped at Point 82 in Matsukasa, extremely close to Ryuumeikan. This happened only moments ago.」
lines.16: 「It is therefore dangerous to remain outside. According to the health center, the animals are quite aggressive.」
lines.17: 「All students on the athletic field must enter the building immediately and wait in their classrooms. That is all.」
lines.19: 「Whoa, did you hear that? Something fun finally happened!」
lines.20: 「It's got nothing to do with us.」
lines.25: 「Let's catch them ourselves and become heroes!」
lines.26: 「How does your broken brain even get there?」
lines.27: 「Dangerous things are a big no-no, okay?」
lines.28: 「There has to be something we can do.」
lines.30: 「Ugh, you have no sense of adventure.」
lines.31: 「I'm pretty sure the hunting party has already deployed.」
lines.34: 「I'll guard the Dragon Gate--Ryuumeikan's front gate. Director, please go search for the dogs.」
lines.35: 「...If possible, I would like them caught before anyone shoots them.」
lines.36: 「Indeed. I doubt anyone will resort to that near the school route, but you are right.」
lines.37: As usual, the wind was strong on the roof.
lines.38: 「Ah, I get it. You can see everything down there from here.」
lines.40: 「Aren't you here to watch too, Yashi?」
lines.41: Yashi shot me an icy look.
lines.43: 「Monkeys and idiots both love high places, huh?」
lines.44: 「You make me want to hurt you every single time.」
lines.46: Best to leave those two alone.
lines.47: 「Hey, that's Otome standing guard at the gate.」
lines.48: 「Whoa, she looks awesome. Yeah, some dog won't stand a chance against Otome.」
lines.50: 「Want me to make you cry for real?」
lines.52: Bringing her up to the roof had been a mistake.
lines.53: I hadn't expected her natural predator to be here.
lines.55: 「Those people in the corner of the field are students from our school, aren't they?」
lines.57: I followed the direction of Yashi's finger.
lines.58: 「She's right. There's a boy and a girl in the corner. What are they doing outside at a time like this?」
lines.62: 「Ooh, look at that. They think nobody's around, so they're making out right on the field.」
lines.64: 「They can flirt all they like, but if a dog comes from Matsukasa Park, it'll reach them first.」
lines.66: 「...No answer. They turned their phones off.」
lines.67: 「Yashi, what do you think of couples like that?」
lines.68: 「They're the worst. I wish the government would crack down on them.」
lines.69: For once, we were on exactly the same wavelength.
lines.71: 「Sappy couples seriously piss me off. Just looking at them gets on my nerves.」
lines.72: 「If I became prime minister, I'd pass a law making vigilante justice against them legal.」
lines.73: 「I'm gonna go warn them they're in danger.」
lines.74: With that, Crab took off running.
lines.82: 「Yeah. From where I'm standing, you're even prettier than the Princess. Shame you don't have a portrait so everybody could see.」
lines.83: 「Our hearts are totally connected. That's love, you know?」
lines.84: 「Yeah. I'm seriously grateful for the miracle that brought us together.」
lines.85: 「I wish time would stop right now.」
lines.88: 「Eek! Is that, like, one of the dogs the Princess mentioned over the PA?」
lines.89: 「W-whoa! That dog's eyes are seriously nuts. If it bites us, we'll catch something really bad!」
lines.91: 「You wanted time to stop, right? Then you can stay frozen right there! Aaaah!」
lines.94: 「You stupid jackass! What kind of man leaves a girl behind and runs? You're pathetic!」
lines.96: 「The hero has arrived! My reward is a hell-sized plate of navy curry.」
lines.97: A hero who demanded payment up front left something to be desired.
lines.100: 「Whoa, its growl sounds like 'bow-wow' now. Guess my English is improving!」
lines.101: 「Quit screwing around! It's about to pounce!」
lines.102: 「Eat the pepper bomb I made to use on Leo!」
lines.104: It struck the dog's snout and burst in a powdery puff.
lines.106: 「Looks like I got its nose instead of its eyes.」
lines.107: 「...I have several questions for later, but nice work. Now let's run.」
lines.108: 「Light a fire under your survival instinct!」
lines.109: 「I wondered what all this noise was. What in the world are you doing?」
lines.111: 「So this is the wandering animal dog.」
lines.115: The stray rolled over and showed us its belly.
lines.117: 「Mammals really are such timid creatures. I only gave it a little scare.」
lines.122: 「The only living things I keep are pretty boys.」
lines.124: 「Father just gave me a new one, too. He told me not to break this one. Hee hee.」
lines.125: 「Rich people and their... appetites... Is that the Princess for you? (Mumble.)」
lines.126: 「...Should we rethink... being friends with her? (Whisper.)」
lines.127: 「Oh, dear. Did you take my joke seriously?」
lines.129: 「You really seem like you might own one.」
lines.130: 「I'm too old to receive presents from Father. You should have realized it was a lie right there.」
lines.133: ...And so the dog incident was over in less than twenty minutes.
lines.134: No local residents had been harmed. City Hall must have been relieved.
lines.136: 「Man, I wish you guys could've seen me in action.」
lines.137: 「Just don't do anything reckless. You're an idiot if you get bitten protecting some stranger.」
lines.139: 「Nah, I'd save anyone here without a second thought. Everybody else can fend for themselves.」
lines.140: 「You could at least save somebody from our class.」
lines.143: 「...Could you stop licking the lid of your ice cream?」
lines.144: 「Well, at least you got the excitement you wanted.」
lines.148: 「So what's going to happen to Komati and Yoshimura now?」
lines.149: 「Hmm. Sounds like they're in a cold war.」
lines.150: 「Ahahaha! I don't know why, but I can't stop laughing!」
